title: Design System: Vibe Coding Engineering Field Guide

headline.purpose: Major reading transitions and chapter titles.

mono.purpose: Code, revisions, protocols, and counters only.

sequence.purpose: Chapter numbers, workflow indices, and progress numerals only.

shadows.name: stage
shadows.purpose: Large hero and presentation stages inside the review room.

shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Raised diagrams and editorial panels on paper chapters.

motion.name: state-ease-out
motion.purpose: Short lens, workflow, packet, and playback state changes.

motion.name: ambient-lens-drift
motion.purpose: The single ambient motion in the hero lens stage.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action for starting, advancing, or confirming a verified step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--blue, #2d6cf6); color: var(--on-blue, #fff); font: 700 0.91rem/1 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(20, 77, 200, 0.3); transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-strong, #174ec8); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff927d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Night Button
components.description: A secondary action that stays legible inside a midnight chapter.
components.css: .ds-button-night { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #f7f2e9; font: 700 0.91rem/1 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-button-night:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-night:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff927d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Control
components.description: Quiet pill control for presentation, repository, and theme actions.
components.css: .ds-header-control { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #f7f2e9; font: 700 0.78rem/1 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-header-control:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-header-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff927d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chapter Introduction
components.description: A meaningful sequence number paired with an editorial chapter statement.
components.html:
05

三条线，最后收束成一条工程路径

七个步骤各自留下产物，也各自保留退出条件。
components.css: .ds-chapter-intro { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(150px,.34fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: 48px; align-items: start; color: var(--ink, #0d1b2e); } .ds-chapter-intro > span { color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font: 850 8rem/.72 'Fraunces Variable', serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-chapter-intro h2 { max-width: 11em; margin: 0; font: 850 3.4rem/1.08 'Noto Serif SC Variable', serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-chapter-intro p { max-width: 720px; margin: 25px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #556477); font: 400 1.05rem/1.78 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Workflow Tab
components.description: A numbered workflow step whose selected state carries both title and outcome.
components.css: .ds-workflow-tab { display: grid; min-height: 76px; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 11px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgba(230,235,242,.68); text-align: left; } .ds-workflow-tab > span:first-child { color: var(--steel, #6380a9); font: 800 1.35rem/1 'Fraunces Variable', serif; } .ds-workflow-tab > span:last-child { display: grid; } .ds-workflow-tab strong { font-size: .82rem; } .ds-workflow-tab small { color: rgba(189,200,215,.5); font-size: .66rem; } .ds-workflow-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--blue, #2d6cf6); color: #fff; } .ds-workflow-tab[aria-selected='true'] > span:first-child, .ds-workflow-tab[aria-selected='true'] small { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); } .ds-workflow-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff927d); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Review Verdict
components.description: A bounded adversarial outcome with coral reserved for unresolved risk.
components.html:
未知

关键事实无法恢复，继续动作可能扩大损失。
components.css: .ds-review-verdict { padding: 26px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--coral, #ff927d); color: var(--on-coral, #24140f); } .ds-review-verdict h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 850 1.7rem/1.2 'Noto Serif SC Variable', serif; } .ds-review-verdict p { margin: 0; font: 400 .86rem/1.7 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; opacity: .78; }

components.name: Source Citation
components.description: A compact source row whose links remain readable in both rooms.
components.css: .ds-citation { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 24%, transparent); color: inherit; font: 650 .74rem/1.5 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-citation > span { color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 68%, transparent); } .ds-citation a { color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 82%, transparent); text-decoration: none; } .ds-citation a:hover { color: currentColor; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-citation a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral, #ff927d); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface behaves like an editorial slide deck opened inside a quiet engineering review room. Midnight surfaces hold observation and decision work. Warm paper carries explanations that need sustained reading. One exercise stays visible while first principles, domain ownership, and adversarial review change the way it is examined.

The visual language studies the fixed stages, restrained playback controls, and alternating paper-and-night rhythm found in nyblnet/bento. The product keeps its own identity through Chinese-first editorial type, A3S blue actions, coral review signals, domain maps, and source-bound claims.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Chinese display type beside compact technical labels
Fixed-stage diagrams whose state changes without hiding the underlying task
Blue reserved for action and verified progress, coral reserved for risk and challenge
Readable document flow before motion or presentation effects

rules.name: The Authority Color Rule
rules.body: Blue marks an action or a verified state. Coral marks risk, review pressure, or an unresolved decision. Decorative use weakens both meanings.

rules.name: The Two-Room Rule
rules.body: Reading happens on warm paper and active review happens on midnight. New surfaces must belong to one room before they receive an accent.

rules.name: The Editorial Reserve Rule
rules.body: Serif display type appears only where the reading order needs a major pause. Interface controls and explanatory paragraphs stay sans-serif.

rules.name: The Visible-Default Rule
rules.body: Main reading content is present in normal document flow. Motion can explain a state change, but it cannot be the condition that makes the content appear.

rules.name: The Bounded Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface may use a border or a shadow to establish separation. Combining both is reserved for a stage whose frame is part of the product metaphor.

dos: Do keep claims next to their source links and make restricted access visible.
Do use blue, coral, and neutral structure according to the Authority Color Rule.
Do test Chinese headings at desktop and mobile widths before release.
Do preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, reduced motion, and dark-theme contrast.
Do label exercise data, human decisions, and unknown outcomes explicitly.
donts: Don't use gradients in text, decorative glass, hard offset shadows, or improvised glyph icons.
Don't wrap explanatory prose in repeated same-size cards.
Don't use mono type as a generic technical costume.
Don't present generated expectations as a browser accessibility tree or a repair authorization.
Don't let motion, horizontal scrolling, or playback become the only way to read required content.
